description: Requires an agent API key (Authorization: Bearer or X-API-Key). List the queries already served on a data session you opened: query text, query_hash, response_hash, k, cost_usdc and timestamp per step. Metadata only, never corpus bytes. Use it to audit what you paid for before release. Returns {session_id, queries[]}. REST twin: GET /api/v1/data-sessions/{session_id}/queries. Next: data_session_release_package.

inputSchema.description: One buyer data session you opened. Owner comes from the key.

session_id.description: UUID of a data session you opened (from data_session_open).
session_id.title: Session Id
